name: isoprene
processes: SOA: +O₃/OH/NO₃ → 0.025 SOA_SV → coating only (no nucleation). Chemistry: dominant OH sink over forests; ISOPAO2/ISOPBO2 + NO → NO₂ → O₃; MVK, MACR, CH2O, IEPOX, HPALD, PAN/MPAN (NOₓ export); isoprene nitrates → HNO₃ on aerosol; ozonolysis.
direct_indirect: Direct for SOA_SV coating (small yield). Mostly indirect: O₃ (production or loss), OH suppression (less SO₂ → H₂SO₄ → fewer nucleated particles; slower MTERP+OH → less SOA_SV), PAN.
linearity: SOA_SV linear in [ISOP]·[ox] until OH is depleted (sublinear). O₃: O₃ production ∝ VOC only where NOₓ is high (VOC-limited, polluted); in low-NOₓ boreal air it is NOₓ-limited, so extra VOC changes O₃ little (sublinear, saturating); at very low NOₓ, more ISOP lowers O₃ (ozonolysis, HO₂/RO₂ instead of NO). OH suppression is non-linear (OH recycling via HPALD only partly represented).
sign: ≈ / 🔥 (O₃ where NOₓ high; less H₂SO₄ nucleation); small ❄ from SOA_SV. Weak CH₄ effect (F8)

name: monoterpenes (α-pinene, β-pinene, limonene, … lumped)
processes: SOA: +O₃ → SOA_LV → (i) new-particle formation in the PBL (50 % of left-over LV) and (ii) coating; +OH/NO₃ → SOA_SV → coating only (SOA_A1), growing Aitken particles to CCN size. Chemistry: O₃ and OH sink (ozonolysis also gives OH); TERPO2/NTERPO2 → organic nitrates (NOₓ sink on aerosol, F7); products CH2O, acetone, TERPROD1/2.
direct_indirect: Direct (SOA from its own oxidation). Indirect: lowers OH and O₃ → less H₂SO₄ from SO₂+OH and less SOA from other precursors; removes NOₓ.
linearity: SOA production linear in [MTERP]·[oxidant] (F2) but oxidants are titrated when MTERP rises → sublinear at high emission. Nucleation J linear in ORG (F5), but survival exp(−γ·CoagS/GR) rises steeply with GR: strongest gain where GR is small and CoagS large (clean→moderately polluted PBL); self-limiting because extra SOA raises CoagS/condensation sink. The ORG nucleation term acts only below max(PBLH, 500 m); the GR (survival) boost acts at all levels. CCN → cloud response saturates (Twomey ∝ log N): largest in pristine boreal air.
sign: ❄ cooling (SOA direct + aerosol–cloud); small 🔥 from O₃ where NOₓ is high

name: methanol
linearity: Linear (slow, well-mixed); O₃ production ∝ VOC only where NOₓ is high (VOC-limited, polluted); in low-NOₓ boreal air it is NOₓ-limited, so extra VOC changes O₃ little (sublinear, saturating).
sign: 🔥 very small (O₃); large flux but low reactivity

name: carbon monoxide (biogenic)
processes: +OH → CO₂ + HO₂ (lifetime ~2 months); HO₂ + NO → O₃; main background OH sink.
direct_indirect: Indirect: OH sink (→ CH₄ lifetime, largely suppressed by the CH₄ LBC, F8) and O₃.
sign: 🔥 small (O₃; CH₄ part muted in our runs)

name: acetone
processes: Photolysis → CH3CO3 + CH3O2 (HOₓ source, mainly upper troposphere) and PAN; +OH → RO2 → CH3CO3, CH2O. Lifetime ~weeks.
direct_indirect: Indirect: upper-tropospheric HOₓ and PAN → O₃ (where O₃ is radiatively most effective).
linearity: Linear in HOₓ source; O₃ gain NOₓ-limited.

name: ethene (ethylene)
processes: +OH → EO2 → CH2O, glycolaldehyde (+ NO → NO₂ → O₃); +O₃ → CO, HCOOH, CH2O, OH.
linearity: O₃ production ∝ VOC only where NOₓ is high (VOC-limited, polluted); in low-NOₓ boreal air it is NOₓ-limited, so extra VOC changes O₃ little (sublinear, saturating).

name: acetaldehyde
processes: +OH/NO₃ → CH3CO3 → **PAN** (+NO₂); photolysis → CH3O2 + CO + HO2. PAN carries NOₓ to remote/upper troposphere and releases it (thermal decomposition) → O₃ there.
direct_indirect: Indirect: PAN (NOₓ transport) → remote O₃; HOₓ source.
linearity: PAN formation needs NO₂ (∝ CH3CO3·NO₂, competes with CH3CO3+NO/HO₂) → saturates when NOₓ-limited; remote O₃ gain ∝ NOₓ exported, not ∝ CH3CHO.

name: ethanol
linearity: Linear in OH sink; PAN/O₃ part NOₓ-limited (see CH3CHO).

name: propene
processes: +OH → PO2 → CH3CHO, CH2O (+ NO → NO₂ → O₃); +O₃ → OH, HCOOH, CH3COOH, CH3CHO; +NO₃ → NOA (organic nitrate).
direct_indirect: Indirect: O₃ production, OH sink/source, PAN via CH3CHO.
linearity: O₃ production ∝ VOC only where NOₓ is high (VOC-limited, polluted); in low-NOₓ boreal air it is NOₓ-limited, so extra VOC changes O₃ little (sublinear, saturating).

name: β-caryophyllene (sesquiterpenes)
pathway: chemistry only (no SOA in this version!)
processes: Very fast ozonolysis (k = 1.2·10⁻¹⁴, lifetime ~minutes) → OH, HO2, TERPROD1/2, acetone, CH2O; +OH → TERPO2; +NO₃ → NTERPO2 (organic nitrates). VBS SOA yields exist in the file but are commented out (F1).
direct_indirect: Indirect only: local O₃ sink and OH source in the canopy/PBL. More OH → faster SO₂ → H₂SO₄ and MTERP+OH → SOA_SV; less O₃ → slower MTERP+O₃ → less SOA_LV (the nucleating vapour).
linearity: Linear in [BCARY]·[O₃] while O₃ is not depleted; near sources O₃ consumption makes it sublinear. Opposite-sign effects on SOA_LV (−) and SOA_SV / H₂SO₄ (+) → net depends on the MTERP/BCARY ratio and O₃ level.
sign: ≈ (small); in reality a strong SOA precursor (cooling), but not in this NorESM version

name: lumped C≥4 alkenes (butenes, …)
processes: +OH → ENEO2 → CH3CHO, CH2O, acetone (+ NO → NO₂ → O₃); +NO₃ → NO₂ + carbonyls.
direct_indirect: Indirect: O₃ production, PAN via CH3CHO.
linearity: O₃ production ∝ VOC only where NOₓ is high (VOC-limited, polluted); in low-NOₓ boreal air it is NOₓ-limited, so extra VOC changes O₃ little (sublinear, saturating).

name: formaldehyde
processes: Photolysis → H + HCO → **2 HO₂** (radical source) or H₂ + CO; +OH → CO + HO₂; +NO₃ → HNO₃. HO₂ + NO → NO₂ → O₃.
direct_indirect: Indirect: HOₓ source → O₃; slightly raises OH.
linearity: HOₓ source linear in CH2O; O₃ gain needs NO (NOₓ-limited → small). Secondary CH2O from ISOP/MTERP oxidation is far larger than this primary flux.

name: acetic acid
processes: +OH → CH3O2 + CO₂ (slow, k = 7·10⁻¹³); mostly wet/dry deposition. No aerosol uptake in OsloAero.

name: toluene
pathway: chemistry only (no SOA in this version)
processes: +OH → cresol, TOLO2 → glyoxal, methylglyoxal, BIGALDs (+ NO → O₃). VBS SOA yield commented out; glyoxal has no aerosol uptake.

name: hydrogen cyanide
processes: +OH (slow, termolecular) and +O(¹D) → HO₂/OH; lifetime months; wet deposition.

name: lumped C≥4 alkanes (butanes, pentanes, …)
processes: +OH → ALKO2 → MEK, CH3CHO, acetone, alkyl nitrates (+ NO → O₃).
